name: Kootenay Riparian Restoration — east bank, Creston Valley
locationNote: Real location on the east bank of the Kootenay River in the Creston Valley, British Columbia. The parcel geometry was chosen from actual Sentinel-2 scene availability and the SCL water mask of scene S2B_11UNQ_20240724_0_L2A. No claim is made that a restoration intervention took place here; the deed, the claim and all Tier 1-3 evidence are constructed for the demonstration. Tier 0 indices are genuine measurements of this ground.
